notes.title: Patch notes v0.6
notes.content:
Version 0.6 is out now for the demo of Dragon Hop!


Changes:
Added option to save game at Checkpoints (also for hardcore mode)

Added a climbable fort as an option to skip the tutorial route

Few more visual changes around the map

Reduced the cost of unlocking Checkpoints to 1 in Exploration Mode

Added borderless windowed mode

Added a few more adjustable settings in the menu

Added ambience sounds

Added camera effects for sprinting and bouncing

Fixed a few issues with navigating windows with a controller

Fixed a bug where the dragon's head would get stuck on edges



This new update adds the option to save the game at certain places. The Checkpoints for Exploration mode are now also visible in Hardcore mode and you can use them in both modes to Save & Quit the game. Once you started a new game, you can continue where you left off by clicking the Continue button in the menu. Collected tokens & unlocked Checkpoints are also loaded in. Coins and Red Feathers are permantently unlocked & can be shown in new games (but they only give rewards once).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705569/a2a89a4e600331aeaa98afed84a322c608a4e785.png"]

Added a huge fort on the map that you can climb as an alternative route. This route doesn't offer tutorials and has many paths to the top. This can be used as a faster way to climb, once you're already familiar with the game.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705569/8d1fd75a3c0acbf6b17e0994b35e00306c2d29ce.png"]

The Checkpoints in their first iteration would prove too costly. Many players didn't find enough Feathers to unlock multiple Checkpoints in a single playthrough, so now all Checkpoints have their cost reduced to 1 Feather in Exploration Mode.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705569/4617d6ac9463f6c814b01a2889ec267103df5953.png"]  

The game now also has a separate store page, so you can leave reviews, if you wish to do so. I'd be very happy to receive them!



Thank you, and as always:

Happy Hopping!

notes.title: Patch notes v0.5
notes.content:
Version 0.5 is out now for the demo of Dragon Hop!

Changes:

 Introducing two different difficulties: Hardcore & Exploration
 Added unlockable skins
 Added 2 new token types you can collect
 Added new teleport mechanic available in Exploration mode
 Massively improved climbing onto platforms
 Improved controls
 New tutorials to explain updated content


This new update aims to tackle the problem of game difficulty and accessibility for players of different skillsets and interests. Through speaking with many of you it became apparent that different players often enjoyed Dragon Hop for completely different aspects. Some players are really keen to test their jumping skills and constantly looking for a stimulating challenge while others like to sit back, take it slow, and enjoy exploring the game and it's many secret treasures.

To solve this divide in interests we made a very simple but fun addition to the game: 2 difficulties. The new Exploration difficulty introduces checkpoints in many parts of the game that can be unlocked. But unlocking them is not free. You'll have to seek out Feathers to unlock them and they can sometimes be... hard to find. Those who like exploration should have no problem though as many times it only takes a bit of sniffing around to discover them. Also, you probably won't find enough Feathers to unlock every single checkpoint, so choose wisely and aim to get the ones where you struggled the most!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705569/dd3a03547aff34189f253087b857c6176e4ec2b2.png


In the meantime, the intended game difficulty is still Hardcore and as the name suggests, it's where there can be quite a bit of struggle before the reward. But there IS a reward, for those who choose to play on Hardcore difficulty the Feathers you find are different: they serve as a special type of currency used to unlock Hardcore specific rewards. The current reward for those who venture into Hardcore mode is a special appearance for your dragon, but there may be different types of rewards in the future.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705569/2d00c8c937c4e4924efb63d8291da78d8f2d4bb3.png


In both difficulties we are also adding another new collectible: Coins. These Coins serve the same general purpose as Feathers in Hardcore mode, only this type of collectible is accessible in both modes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705569/58868a5c435ed405889e5686710266c8febe44f7.png


With this update you'll be able to unlock 2 new appearances for your dragon (inside the demo!), one for Coins and one for Hardcore-mode Feathers.

A new jumping challenge has also be added at the end to make it a bit more interesting for those who have already played.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705569/d237a2c0befe5255e3177c5c22834f7ad7b44477.png


And if you DID play before, and had little success, you may want to give it another shot, as the movement has improved in all aspects so you might find it much easier to perform the "Hopping" part than you did previously.

I hope you all enjoy this update, and I'm always open to your feedback about the game!

Happy Hopping!

notes.title: Dragon Hop Hotfix
notes.content:
A recent effort to improve performance introduced a bunch of glitches into the demo. Most of them should be gone with this new update. If you encounter any further bugs or glitches, please let me know!

Happy Hopping!

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4
notes.content:
Version 0.4 for Dragon Hop demo is live with HUGE changes!

Changes:

 Added new zones: volcano, magic bubble, dark labyrinth!
 Conrtoller support!
 Bouncing clouds
 Added a boat & crabs & turtles
 Cool new grass & vegetation
 New unlockable shortcuts
 Added Height meter
 New loading screen & settings
 Fixed several issues with jumping & movement
 Fixed many colliders & other bugs


In this massive update we are focused on bringing a more comprehensive experience with brand new content & better accessibility. You can finally play the game with a controller!

Explore the new zones added: the ancient volcano, the mysterious magic bubble, and the spooky dark labyrinth. Can you find all of them?

The Kickstarter launch is coming really soon. Follow the link below to get notified, and get unique rewards:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dragonhop/dragon-hop-a-3d-platformer


Follow me on Twitter(/X) for updates: https://twitter.com/DustriderStudio

notes.title: Patch notes v0.3
notes.content:
Version 0.3 for Dragon Hop demo is live!

Changes:

 Many areas in the demo redesigned to make it more fun
 Additional obstacles
 Added 3 shortcuts that you can unlock by reaching them for the first time, keep an eye out for them!
 Made jumping slightly more responsive
 Fixed several colliders
 Changed lighting at nighttime
 Other minor bugfixes


These changes are aimed to make the game more accessible and fun. Even though I'd like to stick to the hardcore element of precision platformers, some unlockable shortcuts should make progress a little bit faster and falling repeatedly not so agonizingly punishing! More updates of this nature to come soon.

In other news, after tons of work the trailer is finally out, and we're slowly gearing up towards a Kickstarter launch. Follow the link below to get notified, and potentially pick up some early bird rewards:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dragonhop/dragon-hop-a-3d-platformer

Follow me on Twitter(/X) for updates: https://twitter.com/DustriderStudio

Happy Hopping!

notes.title: Patch notes v0.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705569/ac535b0d9dda6ee1f861f3d4d5aeefe4a341fd2b.pngThe first major patch (v0.2) for Dragon Hop demo is here!

Changes:

 Revamp of the starting zone
 Working controls menu to change keybinds to your own preferences
 Mouse sensitivity slider
 Field of View slider
 Dragon nest and egg added
 New WATER!!!
 New environmental visual effects
 Unstuck button - to help you out from sticky situations
 Smoother jumping and landing
 Option to disable tutorials

...And dozens of bugfixes!

While these are just some changes for the current demo, the complete game is slowly shaping up as well with many new and unique zones already complete along with gameplay mechanics such as digging for treasures, traps & obstacles, smashing doors, riding carts & other animals ...and shooting your dragon out from a cannon!

For a sneak peek, take a look at the "underwater" coral zone which you will get to explore in the game's full release!

Wanna see more? There might be a game trailer creeping around the corner...  :)

Follow me on Twitter(/X) for updates: https://twitter.com/DustriderStudio

Happy Hopping!
